ask: Is it right to leave release-branch runs out of the flaky-test count?
problem: A web test, PASS-004, looked flaky: it failed in 2 of 27 runs, so the nightly check filed an issue.
found: Both failures were on iPhone release-branch catch-up runs. Those hold older code from 28 October, before main fixed this exact early-read bug on 29 October. Main has no failures.
changed: Nothing changes for people. The nightly flaky-test count now skips release-branch runs. I removed the quarantine I added earlier. The test keeps blocking.
why: I ran the test 14 times here under heavy load and on forced server passes. All passed. Quarantining would have hidden a test that works.
touches: Only the nightly flaky-test report and its test. The release branch gets the test fix when it next catches up with main.
